regime_catalog_policy.reason: Keep the complete original EFFICIENCY regime unchanged as comparator. In BALANCED, remove an old Specialist identity only when all its admitted tasks have selected new winners. BASELINE_RETAINED tasks preserve their entire original pool. A shared retained old checkpoint keeps every frozen capability, including ASR if retained for LID. A selected new checkpoint keeps all quality-admitted frozen measured paths, never an unmeasured path. Generalists and OCR/Image remain unchanged. All old models participated in selection; no dominating baseline may be bypassed.
regime_catalog_policy.unknown_new_g_gt1: NOT_AVAILABLE; no extrapolation or transfer of old-family replica curves
regime_catalog_policy.shared_checkpoint_residency: one identity; if admitted for multiple measured paths use maximum observed per-path mean idle as measured resident envelope, never sum duplicate weights
regime_catalog_policy.matched_count_diagnostic: Also replay both regimes with all searched-task Specialist identities restricted to observed0/1. Keep Generalist and OCR/Image bounds unchanged. Report separately; transitions caused only by unequal evidence bounds cannot establish SUPPORTED gate.

prediction_validation_policy: Compare global and task-local sensitivity guidance with actual joint gamma/mu; no exact breakpoint equivalence claimed. All baseline retained means no new transition test, not evidence that sensitivity mathematics is false.
